snippet.title: Harry Potter Knight Bus Was Real & Ride in London?!
snippet.description: Ever wondered if the Knight Bus in Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban was real? It sure was! This towering three-tiered bus drove through London at night, but not without challenges. The biggest issue? The risk of tipping over! To safely capture the bus zooming around, cars were made to drive slower, and the footage was later sped up.
